The only issue is a tax mismatch. Let me check the arithmetic and the contract clause.

The contract (KTR-V-022#3.1) requires VAT at 11% of subtotal. Correct tax = 17,702,100 × 11% = 1,947,231. The invoice charges 2,124,252.

Let me check what rate 2,124,252 corresponds to: 2,124,252 / 17,702,100 = 0.12 = 12%. So the invoice used 12% instead of the contractual 11%.
